pages.text: Hold leather and right-click the $(item)Tanning Rack$(). The scraper makes one pass; click as it crosses each dark patch. A clean pass makes a $(item)Scraped Hide$(); missed patches can tear it into scraps.
pages.title: Scraping

pages.text: Brew $(item)Bark Liquor$() in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot from four tree bark (chop a log on a cutting board with an axe). Pour it into a cauldron to make a $(item)Tanning Vat$(), then put scraped hides in. Two minutes later, take out $(item)Tanned Leather$().$(br2)The liquor caps the ★: Bark ★3, Tannin ★5, Elder ★7 (the better ones need dungeon herbs).
pages.title: Tanning
